A #HotMakes 🔥 thread! The annual #3DPrintXmasDrive organized by @LoyalMoses's family has officially started! It's currently in the design phase and I've been enjoying creating some new models since summer started. Photos of my new prints in thread below.

@loyalmoses @HotMakesLive @TheEdgeofTeck @cdfairres "Highway Sign" for the City Theme! This is the 4th Annual Christmas Community Print Drive. The sign prints separately from the base. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

This "Mailbox" was one of my first ideas. It prints without supports. We also don't want little parts that could break off easily, so the legs are molded together with the base. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.
The "Stop Sign" prints on it's back so it's easy to print with one filament swap. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

At first my "Trash Can" was only a solid model, but my kids INSISTED that I design one that opens. I've made a nesting version of these too that will be available soon on @Cults3D. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.
This "Cell Phone Toy" is so much fun! It looks good as a single color, but a few filament swaps really make it pop! Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

I love my "City Car"! This is my first time designing something like this. For Print Drive durability, we're printing these with fixed wheels, but my rolling version is coming soon to @Cults3D. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.
The "Traffic Light" was fun to design, but I had some challenges printing with my somewhat antiquated setup. It prints on it's back, so no supports are needed. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.
The "City Scene Box" holds pieces of the street. The box could be a shop, restaurant, business, or whatever your imagination makes it to be! Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

What is a city without a "Street"? I printed these with dual extrusion, but I also designed it to print with one filament swap for single extrusion printing. Keeping them rectangular (not interlocking) makes them more durable for play. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

The "Flatbed Truck" is so fun! Like the City Car, print drive printing will be rigid wheels. Rolling version soon to @Cults3D. I also posted "outline" versions for printers that don't handle the bridging well. Prints on its side. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

In the spirit of efficient packing of toys for the print drive, I had an idea to make a "Skyscraper" that houses a Mailbox. Not yet officially approved for the Print Drive, but it's still super fun! See video below. Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread.

Cont. from above. A #HotMakes 🔥thread. All models currently posted on @Printables and MakerWorld for Print Drive access. Soon I will post on @Cults3D with additional variations and options. Details about the print drive: Happy Printing!
